name: bot_duels_through_its_orders
description: The plan bot (tests/bot.gd, the --bot flag's) plays a duel as the caretaker would, through the game's own duel orders (M7; contract-m7 §2 and §3): against a caretaker, in the window both hollows share it corks with Game.cork the pack SimUndertow.weakest_pack picks within Caretaker.cork_tier's budget, before its plan spends, so its CORK carries the client's commitment and the simulation stands the bottle; from uncork_after_t after the horn it uncorks with Game.uncork, its UNCORK revealing the salt, long before the client's own uncorking at 24 s, and the pack walks the rival's road sent by its seat; with Seawall charges and three creeps at its Holdfast it raises the Seawall with Game.seawall, as Caretaker.wants_seawall says. Every order goes out through the turns (seat 1's CORK, UNCORK and SEAWALL), and it keeps building from the plan. In the window both hollows share the flow bot's --ready-calls (tests/net/flow_bot.gd) wait until the plan bot has played it (played_window), so a Ready on both sides never sounds the horn before the corking. tools/net/smoke.py --mode undertow reads its BOT lines.

steps.msg: its corks went out as CORKs through the turns

steps.assert: mine.size() == corks.size() and mine[0]['uncorked'] and mine[0]['pack'] in ['swarm', 'swift', 'armored', 'winged']
steps.msg: the simulation stood each bottle and took the first's reveal: the salt the client committed to

steps.assert: bot.log.has('bottle %d window %d uncorked %s by bot' % [mine[0]['id'], mine[0]['window'], mine[0]['pack']])
steps.msg: uncorked by the bot itself, not by the client's own at 24 s
its pack walked the rival's road, sent by its seat
and the plan built on beside it
the window both share opens: the flow bot's Ready (--ready-calls) waits for the plan bot's window

steps.assert: bot.played_window == Game.wave + 1 and Game.state == Game.State.PREP and flow._window_played(scene)
steps.msg: once it has corked and built in it, the Ready may go
eight lives lost: two Seawall charges
three lives at the Holdfast: the caretaker would raise the Seawall
the bot raised it through a SEAWALL
and the simulation spent a charge
